definitions.explanation: Pertaining to perception through the five senses.

definitions.gloss: intuitive; based on feeling rather than logic
definitions.explanation: Relying on instinct or feeling rather than rational analysis.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{感覚|かんかく}→感覚：02593_kankaku⟧ (sense, sensation) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (adjectival suffix)

TWO NUANCES:
1. SENSORY: Related to physical senses (sight, sound, etc.)
2. INTUITIVE: Based on gut feeling rather than analysis

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {感覚的|かんかくてき}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧: intuitive judgment
- {感覚的|かんかくてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧: to understand intuitively
- {感覚的|かんかくてき}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{快楽|かいらく}→快楽：27770_kairaku⟧: sensory pleasure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{論理的|ろんりてき}→論理的：05672_ronriteki⟧: logical
- ⟦{理性的|りせいてき}→理性的：16832_riseiteki⟧: rational
